title: Jackpot 102 (NSIC Rc 666H) Hybrid Rice: Characteristics and Grain Quality
metaDescription: Jackpot 102 is NSIC Rc 666H, a hybrid rice for irrigated lowland approved in 2021. See its pest ratings, grain quality and where it grows best.
excerpt: NSIC Rc 666H is a hybrid rice variety for irrigated lowland, sold as Jackpot 102 and known locally as Mestiso 117. The NSIC approved it in 2021. Leads Agriventures bred it. PhilRice has not listed its days to harvest and trial yield yet, but its pest ratings and grain quality are below.

heroImage.alt: Ripe palay heads, the harvest a hybrid like NSIC Rc 666H is bred to fill

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Jackpot 102, or rice variety 666H, this is the one. The facts below come from sources that include PhilRice and its public seed database. So you can compare it with the other varieties in our [rice variety finder](/rice-varieties) before you buy seed. Also read our guide to [rice varieties in the Philippines](/crops/rice-varieties-philippines) for how inbreds, hybrids and special rice differ.

items: **Watch out for:** bacterial leaf blight, tungro.
**Cooked rice:** low amylose, so soft and tender.

blocks.text: How many days does it take, and how much does it yield?

PhilRice has not published this variety's days to harvest and trial yields in its catalogue yet. So ask the seed seller or your municipal agriculturist for the figures from the trials in your region before you plan the season. Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with the [growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it. Meanwhile, our guide to [raising rice yield per hectare](/blog/increase-rice-yield-per-hectare) covers the habits that matter with any variety.

blocks.text: So scout early for [bacterial leaf blight](/diseases/bacterial-leaf-blight), [tungro](/diseases/rice-tungro). When you see the first signs, check the guide before you spray, because the right timing saves more than an extra dose. If you are not sure what you see, our [pest and disease finders](/features/pest-and-disease-finders) help you name it from the damage.

blocks.caption: Grain quality in PhilRice's seed database

blocks.text: Amylose decides how rice cooks. With low amylose, expect rice that is soft. In fact, PhilRice notes that Filipino taste moved from high to intermediate and low amylose rice, because people want it softer. Head rice is the share of whole grains after milling. So a higher number means fewer broken grains and a better price at the mill.

It suits irrigated lowland, where you control the water. Level the field well so the water stands evenly, and plant at the same time as your neighbors, one of the PalayCheck key checks, so pests cannot move from field to field. Our guide to [rice land preparation](/land-preparation/rice-land-preparation) shows each step. For the right month in your province, see [the best time to plant rice](/blog/best-time-to-plant-rice-philippines).

items.q: Is Jackpot 102 the same as NSIC Rc 666H?
items.a: Yes. Jackpot 102 is the name it is sold under, and NSIC Rc 666H is its registration with the National Seed Industry Council, where its local name is Mestiso 117. The numbers on this page are PhilRice's for NSIC Rc 666H.

items.q: What is the local name of NSIC Rc 666H?
items.a: It is known as Mestiso 117. Seed sellers and agriculturists use both names, so ask for either one.
The NSIC approved it in 2021. Leads Agriventures bred it. PhilRice has not listed its days to harvest and trial yield yet, so ask for the regional trial figures before you plant.
Yes. So buy new seed each season, because seed saved from a hybrid crop does not grow true and yields less.

items.q: What should I watch for when I plant it?
items.a: In PhilRice's tests it was weak against bacterial leaf blight, tungro. So scout from the early weeks and act at the first signs.
It has low amylose, 14.8 percent. So it cooks soft.
